description: Delete a draft, scheduled or paused post that was created through the API, cancelling its pending publish. Refused with 409 when the post was created in the Flomixy app, or when any network target is already published or publishing. It never deletes anything on a social network. Use delete_draft for app-created drafts. Requires scope POSTS_WRITE.

id.description: The draft, scheduled or paused post id.

name: delete_post
title: Delete scheduled post
